tool_description: retfound_de is an open-source deep learning tool that supports automatic classification of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR), Glaucoma, and Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) using pretrained models on various datasets.

input.description: Path to the input folder containing fundus images.

output.description: Path to the output folder where the prediction results will be saved.

task.description: Specify the classification task: DR (Diabetic Retinopathy), Glaucoma, or AMD (Age-related Macular Degeneration).

train_dataset.description: Name of the dataset used to fine-tune the model (e.g., aptos, messidor, idrid, glaucoma_fundus, papila, origa, areds).

results_csv.description: Path to the output CSV file that contains prediction results for each image.

description.Name: Image file name (same as in input folder)
description.raw_Prediction: Raw model output (original class index predicted by the model before any post-processing or mapping)
description.Prediction: Final prediction after task-specific mapping (e.g., AMD or Glaucoma may map raw classes to binary)
description.confidence: Predicted probability of the final class
description.class_3_prob: Probability of class 3 (only for DR or AMD)
